pages.title: Tastes Like Chicken
pages.text: Toronto is the eighth race in Skitchin', and Tastes Like Chicken is its song. Canadian races are measured in kilometers, so the course is listed as 10.3 km. The password is JAYS, for the Toronto Blue Jays, who won the World Series in 1992 and 1993, the two years the game was being made.

pages.title: The stuntman from Toronto
pages.text: At Toronto's Skate Ranch, the Skitchin' team asked for the best skater around and met Troy Mannering. In a warehouse, Troy was towed behind a programmer's car to hit the ramps, and the team traced the film into the game. Designer Dave Warfield says everyone could feel the car's carbon monoxide for the rest of that day.

pages.title: A password named after Troy
pages.text: Stuntman Troy Mannering has a secret password named after him. Enter TROY, and you get what the game calls "improved fighting."
